'''Glok monsters''' were [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like creatures on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. They were native to the [[glop pits]] and attacked intruders into their area. Glok monsters took to sleeping under the ground and would "erupt" out of the dirt when attacking. The [[stranger]] once used the power of the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]] to control a glok monster in his [[Stranger War|campaign]] against the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. The monster was able to capture the Ewok child [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] before being accosted by [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] with a potion of [[itching powder]].
